# URLCode form-records

> Operator-installed composition of forms and store: a declared form's
> validated submission creates a record private to its signed-in creator in an
> `ownership: owner` store collection, a confirmation page reads the saved
> record back, and an edit page changes only declared fields. Released as a
> tarball on core's GitHub Release and installed with
> `urlcode extensions add form-records`; only core is on npm. Apache-2.0.

Part of the URLCode framework, in the same repository: docs/FRAMEWORK.md

## What a project declares (YAML only; never packages, code or credentials)
- `extensions.forms` and `extensions.store` declared too (in any order).
- A store collection with `ownership: owner` (and its own `auth: {csrf: origin}` route).
- `extensions.form-records: { version: "1", config: { records: { <name>: { mount, collection, form, fields?, editable?, editTitle?, list?: { title?, columns } } } } }`;
  `form` is a forms flow body without `mount`.
- A route `<mount>/*` with `extension: form-records`, methods GET, HEAD and POST, and `auth: {csrf: origin}`
  (forms verifies its own token; auth's default token header cannot come from a plain HTML form).

## Read in this order
- [README](README.md): the record flow declaration, paths, ownership, concurrency and the example.
- [SECURITY](SECURITY.md): what it delegates to forms and store, and what it enforces itself.

## Do not guess
- No handler code, in-process map or HTML for "save a form, show it, edit it":
  declare a record flow.
- Records are private to their creator: shared collections and mounts without
  a principal-providing policy are refused at startup. For a per-user list,
  declare `list: { columns: [<form fields>] }` (served at `<mount>/`); do not
  write a list handler.
- An editable field emptied on the edit page is removed from the record; a
  required collection field refuses that with a 422.
- Only `editable` fields change after create; a stale edit is a 412 page and
  saves nothing. forms' `onSubmit` hook does not run for these forms.
- Node only, like the store.
